description: "Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to summon a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3777|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. \n\nThe scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain."
